program.name: Strong Hips
program.subject: Strength & stretch
program.blurb: Leg strength followed by hip mobility, so the hips can use the strength you build.
program.about: Leg strength and hip mobility in the same session. Squat, hinge and single-leg days each end with a flow of hip drills and stretches, like 90/90 switches, hip circles, pigeon and deep squat holds. The lifting is straight sets with dumbbells and a kettlebell. Level II moves you one weight up and Level III adds reps, and the hip flow gets a little longer each level. Good for lifters whose hips feel tight, and for desk days that left them stiff.
program.split: Squat / hinge / single-leg, each with hip mobility
program.gear: A sturdy chair or couch for step-ups and hip thrusts.
